facts.value: No proof through the Abitur certificate is accepted unless it is explicitly stated in the certificate that you have unrestricted access to foreign universities through language acquisition.

facts.value: If you do not speak the local language of the target country, we recommend that you acquire basic knowledge of the respective language if possible, although this is not a requirement for application.
